description: Typed result every platform must produce from each app-config sample and valid fixture. `fields` says what each value means and which platforms are held to it. `knownDrift` records where a platform differs today (A9.2: drift is recorded, not changed, in this program). A conformance test passes a case when the platform matches `expected`, or when it differs only in a field named in its knownDrift entry. Remove a knownDrift entry in the same change that fixes it.

mobileZids.meaning: Feed ad zones. ios/android: MOBILE_ZID_<OS> when non-empty, else [MOBILE_ZID_ALL_<OS>] when non-empty, else MOBILE_ZID. shared: MOBILE_ZID. core has no OS and must produce shared; react-native, ios, android and flutter must produce the value for the OS they run on.

mobileBannerZid.meaning: Mobile banner zone. <OS>: MOBILE_BANNER_ZID_<OS> when not '', else MOBILE_ZID_ALL_<OS> when not '', else MOBILE_BANNER_ZID when it is text; null = unset (platform default).

adRefreshIntervalMs.meaning: AD_REFRESH_INTERVAL in milliseconds; null = unset (platform default 30000). iOS stores seconds (adRefreshInterval = ms / 1000); Flutter stores a Duration.

iabCats.meaning: IAB_CATS as a list: a list stays as is; text is split on commas, trimmed, empties dropped.

adStack.meaning: Parsed AD_STACK (null when unset or unknown), parsed AD_STACK_BY_ZONE (unknown modes dropped), and the resolved stack for zones 43, 280, 999 (global wins, then per zone, then both).

failuresEnabled.meaning: coerceFlag(FAILURES_ENABLED); absent = true. A local failuresEnabled override would win.

appBundleId.meaning: APP_BUNDLE_ID_<OS> when it is text (even empty), else APP_BUNDLE_ID; null = unset.

appStoreUrl.meaning: APP_STORE_URL_<OS> when it is text (even empty), else APP_STORE_URL; null = unset.

publisherId.meaning: OpenRTB app.publisher.id: PUBLISHER_ID when not '' (numbers as text), else SELLER_ID; null = none.

s2sConfigText.meaning: S2S_CONFIG text passed through unchanged (core s2sConfig); null when '' or absent.

bannerSizesByZone.meaning: Extra banner sizes (after the primary) per zone 43, 280, 999: BANNER_SIZES_BY_ZONE[zone] when that map has the zone, else BANNER_SIZES. Entries that do not parse or are not positive are dropped, duplicates removed, sizes as [width, height] integers.

houseAd.meaning: House-ad backfill for zone 43 at 300x250: enabled flag (absent = on; false/0/no/off = off) and the candidate creatives the random pick chooses from (BY_ZONE, then BY_SIZE, then IMAGE/URL; blank images skipped; url paired by index or shared).

localizedListings.meaning: Resolved remote LOCALIZED_LISTINGS (object or JSON text): null when absent, disabled or missing baseUrl/urlTemplate; else source, baseUrl, urlTemplate, frequency (number, text parsed, default 0), forceState (upper case), the cache URL for forceState or AL, and everyNth (round(100 / frequency); 0 off; 1 at 100+).

auctionBidderParams.meaning: Bidder params forwarded to the native Prebid auction: the BIDDERS object.

bridgeKnownDrift.react-native-android: The Android bridge re-serializes `remote` with ReadableMap.toHashMap(), which turns every JSON integer into a double (48 becomes 48.0). SellwildSDK.apply then sees doubles for integer keys and numeric zone ids.
bridgeKnownDrift.react-native-ios: `as? String` drops numeric bannerZid/bottomBannerZid/mobileBannerZid/mobileZids from the native config (the TS default bannerZid is the number 0).
